reviews.comment: Prof. Harvey is great! She is always willing to go out of her way to help students succeed. She's also a great and engaging lecturer. Exams will be kinda hard if you don't study, so definitely learn the information! Prof. Harvey posts a lot of helpful resources on Canvas so it won't be that hard.

Prof. Harvey was a GREAT instructor and I loved taking her class. Lectures were engaging and felt like I was being taught by a real human and not a teaching machine. Exams were a little difficult, but if you study notes and things the mentions from the book you'll be okay. Very fun class and not too many assignments.

Instructor Harvey cares deeply for her students and their success and her lectures are very engaging. Tests can be challenging but she offers online optional review sessions prior that are extremely helpful. Also posts reviews that are exactly like the test. Take SOCI211 with Harvey. She's a true gem.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Grades are mainly just tests and participation. The tests are very in-depth, but if you listen to the lectures they aren't crazy difficult. Attendance wasn't mandatory but the lectures were very informative and helpful!
This woman was incredible! My favorite prof so far. I absolutely loved studying deviance and Harvey made the class so interesting!

The work isnt bad if you read the chapters, attend lectures, and fill out those outlines! If you procrastinate it then good luck because her exams are too difficult to not have an IN DEPTH understanding. Good news is she usually gives back like 2-4 points after each exam. No extra credit, or open note though! Participation is online and super easy

Professor Harvey is a super sweet and knowledgeable professor. She was my favorite prof this semester! Her lectures are informational, and lots of time there is a lot of discussion, so it's important to show up! Sometimes she'll post the discussions online, but it's really beneficial to be there in person.

This class is a lot of work. The chapters are long as in 30-50 pages. The exams cover every little thing taught in the book, so you basically need to master everything. A lot of reading + attending lectures or watching her videos of lectures (1 hour long). Difficult exams. She likes to act like she curves/grades easy but she do not. Not open note.
Class is tough, would recommend going in person for a better chance. She is super nice though and you can talk to her and she will do a lot to help you pass you just need to reach out.

I just wanted to say her exams are not open note like other reviews stated. That was when everything was online and Covid. Her in class exams are tough. Many of the students fail the exam and if you want to pass with an A you need to understand every single concept very well! The exams are extremely dense with so much information squeezed into them

Sociology 211 with Harvey is NOT a blow off class ppl! You MUST read the textbook to pass the exams. Her lectures are okay but will NOT help you pass the exam. The exams are TOUGH. Not memorization and she throws in many trick questions. You can get A if you read textbook and practice the concepts. I wouldnt recommend for a grade boost.

I took this as a summer online class and it was super easy. Few assignments but they are all simple and she grades easy. Her exams are open note and very easy if you just take good notes during her lectures. I bought the book but never really used it even though she says its mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Instructor Harvey is so kind and her lectures are very interesting! There are only about 7 assignments throughout the semester but they aren't difficult. As long as you complete those on time and take notes during class, it is an easy A. She is very helpful and understanding to anyone who needs help.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class consisted of 2 essays, a project, and weekly discussions. Work load was about average. She really cares about her students and will make sure you understand the material. Lectures were amazing and thorough. Textbook was helpful for the essays and further info. Overall a great soci class.

Read the syllabus thoroughly about how she grades. If you do not get a certain amount of points for participation, you get a 0% for it even if you do some of them, brought my grade down a letter because I did not read that part. Participation points  going to class. Overall, she is nice and the class can be interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She won't answer your questions right away and will ask you to email her. The book was mandatory, and she provides powerpoints but you can't access them online. She used tophat to check attendance and used them for grading.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: - Every class is powerpoint lecture that isn't online - Does poll everywheres so if you don't want to go to class just do those online at home during reg. class time - Tests don't seem difficult but then everyone gets a lowish grade - Pretty good prof overall - Can be loud if standing next to you - Does test reviews
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Decent prof. Sometimes it seems like she really doesn't seem like she understands the material well herself. PollEverywhere used almost every day for participation points, so go to class. Tests are kind of hard even with studying. Must read chapters.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS
